faqReplacements.question: What Montenegro eSIM plans does DALO compare?

faqReplacements.replacementQuestion: Does a Montenegro plan cover an onward Balkan journey?
faqReplacements.answer: Check every country on your itinerary against the package list. Montenegro coverage alone does not confirm service in Albania, Croatia or Serbia; compare regional options before you buy.
